title: Primer ID MiSeq Library Prep for HIV-1 Drug Resistance and Diversity
author: Shuntai Zhou
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.6hchb2w
materials: Complete thaw and vortex KAPA reagents (except for enzyme) before use.
Gel purification. (Qiagen QIAquick gel extraction kit) Run 2 nd round PCR products on 1.2% agarose gel. E = 4 V/cm, T = 60 min.
Quantification using Invitrogen Qubit dsDNA BR Assay kit. See Qubit dsDNA BR assay protocol. Don’t use Nanodrop to quantify!
Quantify the pooled library using Qubit dsDNA BR assay kit. Check the quality of the library by Agilent Bioanalyzer or Bio-rad Experion. Repeat purification if primer dimmer is present (~200bp).

steps.title: Prepare Primer Mix
steps.instruction: Create a 10 µM primer mix for multiplexing sequencing.

substeps.instruction: Mix 10 µL of each primer in one set with 60 µL of dH2O.
Mix well.

steps.title: Initial cDNA Synthesis Setup
steps.instruction: Combine initial components in a 0.5 ml RNase-free tube.

substeps.instruction: Add dNTPMix, cDNA primer, and RNA template (volumes undetermined).

steps.title: Denature RNA Template
steps.instruction: Heat the tube in a 65°C heat block for 3-5 minutes.

steps.title: Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Perform reverse transcription using SSII RT.

substeps.instruction: Add 5x buffer, DTT, RNaseOUT, and SSII RT (volumes undetermined).
Mix and incubate at 50°C for 1 hour.
Increase temperature to 55°C and incubate for 1 hour.
Inactivate SSIII RT by heating at 70°C for 15 minutes.

steps.title: RNase H Treatment
steps.instruction: Remove RNA template from cDNA hybrids.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 μl RNase H to each tube.
Incubate at 37°C for 20 minutes.

steps.title: Purify cDNA with Agencourt RNAClean XP
steps.instruction: Purify the cDNA using magnetic beads.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend Agencourt RNAClean XP beads (1ml aliquots) and let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.
Transfer cDNA reactions into 1.7 mL RNase-free tubes.
Vortex to resuspend beads and add 28 µl of beads to 40 µl of cDNA.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting 15 times (do not vortex).
Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes.
Place on a magnetic tube rack for 5 minutes to separate beads.
Slowly aspirate and discard the cleared solution while the tube remains on the rack.
Dispense 400 μL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature, then aspirate and discard. Repeat this wash a second time.
Air-dry the tube on the rack with the cap open for 10 minutes until ethanol evaporates.
Remove from rack and resuspend beads in 40 µl DNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Place back on the rack for 3 minutes.
Remove from rack and resuspend beads in 24 µl DNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Place back on the rack for 3 minutes.
Pipette the eluant from the tube while it is on the magnetic rack.

steps.title: Perform First PCR (PCR1)
steps.instruction: Amplify the cDNA using a mastermix in a cold box.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix containing 5x Buffer A, Enhancer, dNTPs, Forward primer, ADPT_2a, and KAPA Robust polymerase.
Use a repeater pipette to add the mastermix to each tube in the cold box.
Add template cDNA to each tube and mix by pipetting up and down.

steps.title: Purify PCR Products with AmpureXP
steps.instruction: Clean up PCR1 products using AmpureXP beads.

substeps.instruction: Vortex 1 ml aliquot of Ampure XP beads and let stand at room temperature for at least 30 minutes before use.
Transfer PCR1 reactions into 1.7 mL RNase-free tubes.
Add 40 µl (Ratio: 0.6–0.8:1, 36µl–48µl) Ampure XP beads to each reaction.
Mix thoroughly by vortexing and incubate off the rack at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Place on a magnetic tube rack for 5 minutes to separate beads.
Slowly aspirate and discard the cleared solution while on the rack.
Dispense 500 μL of 70% ethanol, incubate for 30 seconds at room temperature, then aspirate and discard. Repeat this wash a second time.
Air-dry the tube on the rack with the cap open for 10 minutes.
Remove from rack and resuspend beads in 50 µl DNase-free water by pipetting up and down.
Place back on the rack for 3 minutes.
Pipette 45 µl of eluant from the tube while on the magnetic rack.

steps.title: Perform Indexing PCR
steps.instruction: Add indexed adapters to the purified DNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a mastermix in a cold box containing 5x KAPA HiFi Fidelity Buffer, dNTP Mix, Uni Adapter (ADPT_P1), KAPA HiFI polymerase, and water.
Add the mastermix and the Indexed Adapter to the purified template DNA in each tube.

steps.title: Gel Purification of Libraries
steps.instruction: Isolate the desired bands via agarose gel electrophoresis and extraction.

substeps.instruction: Run 2 µl of products on a 1% agarose gel to verify bands.
Weight the gel slice and add 3 volumes of Buffer QG to 1 volume of gel.
Incubate at 50°C for 10 minutes to dissolve, vortexing every 2-3 minutes.
Verify the solution is yellow; if not, add 10 µl 3M sodium acetate.
Apply sample to a MinElute column and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Add 500 µl Buffer QG and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Add 0.75 ml Buffer PE, incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature, and centrifuge for 1 minute.
Discard fluid and centrifuge for an additional 3 minutes.
Transfer column to a new 1.7 ml tube, add 10 µl Buffer EB, let stand for 4 minutes, and centrifuge for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Pool and Final Purify Libraries
steps.instruction: Pool quantified libraries and perform final cleanup.

substeps.instruction: Pool libraries in equal amounts after quantification.
Purify pooled libraries using AMPure XP beads (2:3 ratio, two washes).
Elute in 20 to 30 µL Elution Buffer.
Place the tube on ice for 1 minute.
Pipette the eluant from the tube while on the magnetic rack and transfer into a tube containing 28 µl of RNAcleanup XP beads.
